post.description: Submits a course play log with the fingerprint documents of each played stage and the charts of the stages it never reached. The body is JSON, gzip-compressed (`Content-Encoding: gzip`). Every played stage is checked like a single play, every unreached stage’s facts must be its chart’s, the run is re-simulated under every ruleset, and each stage’s carry-in must be the state the previous stage, re-simulated, left. A run given up with ESC on its last stage played is a failed run; one that stopped before the last stage otherwise must have failed there, or it is refused as `aborted`. A NONSTOP run sends every stage chart instead of documents: the server stitches them again, the stitched play must have been recorded on that chart, and the stitched play is re-simulated (given up with ESC, it is a failed run). A course run creates no chart scores. The same run submitted again by the same account answers 200 with the stored result. Rejections name the stage at fault in `detail` when there is one.

playDocument.description: Fingerprint document of the stage chart as played; it must hash to the stage’s `chart.playFingerprint`.

chartDocument.description: Fingerprint document of the whole stage chart. Required the first time the server sees the chart.

stages.description: The fingerprint documents of each played stage, in the order the stages were played. Empty for a NONSTOP run, whose stages are rebuilt from `stageCharts`.

chart.description: The stage chart as loaded (`BeMusicJson`, `#RANDOM` still in); it must hash to the stage’s chart fingerprint. Used to verify the run, never stored.

pms.description: Whether the chart is a `.pms` file (a lane-mode input).

stageCharts.description: The charts of the stages the server rebuilds: every stage the run never reached (their notes count as BP), and every stage of a NONSTOP run (stitched again to verify the play).

200.description: Already submitted by this account: the stored result.

ruleset.description: Ruleset the figures are simulated under.

rulesetRevision.description: Revision of the ruleset the run was simulated under (`lr2/0`, ...).

noteCount.description: Judgment notes over every stage, reached or not.
